explanation_full:
The incremental feature analysis reveals the optimal feature subset for each model. For KNN, the best performance was achieved with 9 features (VFA -> Butyrate -> Acetate -> VSS -> Propionate -> Ethanol -> COD-O -> pH -> ORP_Low), yielding an R² of 0.8301 and an MSE of 0.0119. Similarly, RF performed best with 11 features, and SVM with 4 features. 

When considering the overall model performance on the full test set, KNN is the superior model, achieving the highest R² (0.8172) and the lowest MSE (0.0128). The feature importance ranking suggests that VFA, Butyrate, and Acetate are the most influential features, followed by VSS and Propionate. The results indicate that while feature selection is crucial, the overall model performance of KNN remains strong across various feature subsets, making it the recommended model.
